decisions.executionNote: Begin right-arm approach to the near standing red-capped bottle; small increments preserve the initial elbow configuration. Left arm stays clear.

Lift and move the red bottle toward the left, keeping the closed jaws and downward orientation unchanged; check retention before traversing the bin.

Complete the vertical-jaw receiving orientation and approach the blue neck from the left while the right keeps the bottle level. Do not release yet.
Seat the left fingers around the exposed blue shoulder, close and pause with both hands supporting it, then open the right gripper for the handover test.
The left jaws closed beside the bottle, not around it. Re-secure with the right hand and reopen/reposition the left lower and toward the blue shoulder before retrying.
The blue bottle fell onto the table during the handover attempt. Clear the right hand and bring the left open hand above its new central position for recovery.

Approach the centrally settled blue bottle diagonally with the left hand, keeping its wrist on the left side. Move the empty right wrist farther clear.

Regrasp the blue bottle deeper around its white body with the right hand. The left prepares a downward receiving grasp while staying clear.
Lift the regrasped blue bottle level and carry it inward to a supported transfer location. Keep the left hand still and separated.
Lower the right-held bottle onto the table near the midline for a supported handover, keeping the right wrist on its own side. Release only at the low endpoint.
